venue: Copa Room at Tuscany Suites & Casino

zones.label: VIP
zones.description: VIP covers every seating area ahead of General Admission: the central floor, the small tables near the stage and both side groups. In this cozy showroom, these seats keep you closer to the performers from either a straight-on or side angle.

zones.label: General Admission
zones.description: General Admission sits behind the central VIP section, giving you a broader view of the stage. The Copa Room is a cozy showroom, so you're still part of a small-room setting.
